facts.fact: Jessica 近三十年没领圣餐，也没告解、没念玫瑰经、没上教堂，父母当年说这些都是不可饶恕的死罪
facts.anchor: Jessica had not received the sacrament of communion in nearly thirty years

facts.fact: Jessica 的本职是对公司一切决定表现热情——她是 Ungo.com™ 初级副总裁（implementation and implementainment 方向）的妻子
facts.anchor: as the wife of an Ungo.com™ junior vice president for implementation and implementainment, to be enthusiastic about anything that the company decided

facts.fact: 上司 Stan 把 Greg 一家派往 Hasenhurst，让 Greg 与镇上的父老完成一桩神秘生意
facts.anchor: Stan was sending her family there so her husband, Greg, could complete some sort of arcane business deal with the town fathers of Hasenhurst

facts.fact: Sandy 游泳时穿全身潜水服，Jessica 正在预备迎接 Stan's wife 必然的一问
facts.anchor: Sandy wore a full-body wet suit when they went swimming

facts.fact: Sandy 的紫色长发湿漉漉贴在背上，正准备第二次跳水
facts.anchor: Their long purple hair hung down past their shoulders, wet and plastered to their back.

facts.fact: Stan's wife 的正职是 UC Berkeley 比较文学教授，厨艺待客是业余修出来的
facts.anchor: from being a professor of comparative literature at UC Berkeley

facts.fact: Jessica 四十六岁，自认在公司派对上不再引人回头，担心丈夫厌倦「没用的 trophy wife」
facts.anchor: now that she was forty-six and didn’t turn heads at Ungo.com™ company parties

facts.fact: Sandy 十五岁——Jessica 心里认定这是孩子不再需要母亲、父亲说「妈妈得走」他们也能承受的年纪
facts.anchor: Sandy was fifteen; that was the age that children didn’t need their mothers anymore

facts.fact: Jessica 在写一本给年轻人的奇幻故事：一个不守规矩的公主，最初是给 Sandy 编的睡前故事
facts.anchor: It’s a fantasy story for young people, about a princess who doesn’t follow the rules
